body: The original crash-child failure did not recur in 24 complete runs (144 write checkpoints), including concurrent runs; its cause remains unknown. Separately, recent GitHub CI failures on both Ubuntu and macOS traced to an autosave test measuring full HTTP response latency against a 350 ms debounce assertion. A delayed response reproduced the false failure. The test now requires the discrete write while browser timers are paused and still verifies its durable acknowledgement and source. All ten autosave scenarios and the full local gate pass. Added weekly, dependency-change and manually triggered OSV checks for the three pinned npm/Cargo/Python lockfiles, with findings and incomplete scans failing CI; dependencies are unchanged. Local scan returned no matching advisories; known-vulnerable and missing-input fixtures fail as expected. Editor simplification and compatibility explanation remain next. Evidence/checkpoint: progress/2026-09-29-stability-followup.md. Acceptance and card statuses are unchanged.

metadata.summary: Stability follow-up: bounded crash diagnostics and dependency advisory CI
